  AGENDA STAFF REPORT

  DATE:  October 5, 2021

  TO:  Honorable Mayor and Members of the City Council

  APPROVED BY: Ernie Hernandez, City Manager

  PREPARED BY: Noel Tapia, City Attorney

  SUBJECT:  CONSIDERATION OF THE FORMATION OF A CITY COUNCIL AD HOC
  COMMITTEE TO MONITOR THE CITY’S PROGRESS TO COMPLY WITH THE
  FOLLOW-UP AUDIT TO THE 2018 AUDIT REPORT PREPARED BY THE AUDITOR
  OF THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA

  Recommendation:

  That the City Council form an Ad Hoc Committee and appoint two Councilmembers to serve on the Ad Hoc
  Committee to monitor the City’s progress to comply with the follow-up audit to the 2018 Audit Report prepared by
  the Auditor of the State of California.

  Background:

  The City Council may, from time to time, announce appointments to ad hoc advisory committees composed solely
  of less than a majority of the members of the City Council. The purpose of this item is to establish a City Council
  Ad Hoc Committee to monitor the City’s progress to comply with the follow-up audit to the 2018 Audit Report
  prepared by the Auditor of the State of California and ensure quarterly reports are prepared by the City to
  document the City’s progress. The Committee’s scope of work will be determined and defined in initial meetings.

  Discussion and Analysis:

  On September 23, 2021, the Auditor of the State of California published a follow-up audit report to the 2018 Audit
  Report. The follow-up audit report identified certain monitoring and reporting procedures that need to be adopted
  by the City. The City Council desires to create an ad hoc committee comprised of two members of the City
  Council to meet monthly with City staff to discuss the progress the City is making to comply with all of the areas
  identified in the follow-up audit report that require City action. The City Council desires to ensure that the City’s
  progress is reported on a quarterly basis.
